packageRules.description: Group all patch-level updates into a single PR
Group all minor-level updates into a single PR

jenkins-lib-common is tracked on the dt3-pipeline branch on purpose; do not propose replacing the branch ref with a tag. The shared Jenkinsfile custom manager uses the github-tags datasource and treats @dt3-pipeline as a version. We will pin a tag manually once dt3-pipeline is merged.

Keep ubuntu Docker base images on the 24.04 (noble) LTS line; do not auto-bump the OS major (the runtime image runs the native binary directly against glibc). Bump manually when there is a concrete driver.
